title: Synth executor
description: Synthesize the CDK app of this project into a CloudFormation template.

stacks.description: Stacks to synthesize. Accepts stack names or glob patterns, space separated. Defaults to every stack in the app.

profile.description: Name of the AWS profile (from ~/.aws/credentials or ~/.aws/config) to use.

context.description: Additional CDK context values as KEY=VALUE pairs. Pass the option multiple times for multiple values.
